purpose: Live re-verification that the platform's propulsion block still returns relative_rot_eff = 1.0 and that its K_T/K_Q are its own open-water curve, on two states of the W30 state grid (S1 at 12 kn, P/D 0.95; S11 at 15 kn, P/D 1.05). Consumed by benchmarks/anchors/build_w31_etaR_chain.py.

provenance.transport: tool channel call_ship_api (loopback curl is blocked by the worktree sandbox); the two response bodies below are verbatim copies of the tool payloads, field names and precision unchanged (2 dp kW, 4 dp non-dimensional)
